_what_this_is: the discover step's proposals (model call); the confirm step looks each up in the registries

proposals.title: Digital tracking, provider decision support systems, and targeted client communication via mobile devices to improve primary health care
proposals.why: Most recent Cochrane review (18 RCTs) directly addressing digital tracking, CDSS, and patient messaging in primary care.

proposals.title: Decision-support tools via mobile devices to improve quality of care in primary healthcare settings
proposals.why: Cochrane review of 8 studies on mobile CDSS (checklists, protocols) used by primary/community health workers.

proposals.title: Targeted client communication via mobile devices for improving maternal, neonatal, and child health
proposals.why: Cochrane review assessing SMS/mobile reminders to patients for MNCH outcomes; informs WHO 2019 guideline.

proposals.title: Targeted client communication via mobile devices for improving sexual and reproductive health
proposals.why: Cochrane review of mobile-device targeted messaging to patients for sexual/reproductive health service use.

proposals.title: Mobile phone messaging reminders for attendance at healthcare appointments
proposals.why: Foundational Cochrane review showing SMS reminders increase appointment attendance vs. no reminders or postal reminders.

proposals.title: WHO Guideline: Recommendations on Digital Interventions for Health System Strengthening
proposals.why: First WHO evidence-based guideline recommending health worker decision support and targeted client communication via mobile devices.

proposals.title: The Impact of mHealth Interventions: Systematic Review of Systematic Reviews
proposals.why: Umbrella review of 23 systematic reviews (371 studies) on mHealth effectiveness across health conditions and care processes.

proposals.title: Effectiveness of Single-Component Clinician Reminder Systems for Smoking and Obesity Preventive Care in Primary Care: A Systematic Review
proposals.why: 2025 systematic review and meta-analysis of on-screen clinician reminder systems for preventive care in primary care settings.
